speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: By the way, another accepted usage for the term ho.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Good-Bye, Sheldon.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Hold on I believe that social convention dictate you not arrive empty-Handed. Would you like to bring some Cylon toast?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Yeah, no, I'm trying to fit in, not get laughed at.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: What's funny about Cylon toast?

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: It's open.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Hey, pal.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: What do you want?

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: I brought you a little gift. New kite.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: The kite you made me lose was an authentic Patang, an Indian fighting kite that my brother sent to me from New Delhi. It took me a day to put together and two days to paint. This is Hello Kitty.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Yeah, but it comes with a little coin purse. Does a Patang?

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Wow, you just don't get it, do you? Buying me something pretty isn't going to make our problem just go away.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Look, I admit I haven't always been the best friend I could be.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: You've been a sucky friend, a sucky, sucky friend.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Stipulated.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: And you do it all the time. Last week in the mall at Radio Shack, we were looking for a phone with giant numbers for your mother, and I suddenly realize you're not even there. And where were you?

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: I know, I know. Getting shot down by the girl at Hot Dog on a Stick. But in my defence, she was gorgeous, and working that squeezer to make the lemonade, going up and down and up and down. It was like a free pole dance right in the middle of the food court.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: You're impossible.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Hey, at least I can talk to women without being drunk.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Excuse me, I have selective mutism, a recognized medical disorder. You're just a douche.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: No. You know what? Maybe that's what this whole thing's about. You're not mad at me, you're mad at yourself.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: No, I'm mad at you. I hate myself, but I'm mad at you.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Fine. You're mad at me. I get it. Now, how about we go spend the day together? Just the two of us. We'll go anywhere you want.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: I don't know.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Come on. Let me take you someplace nice.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: I... I do enjoy the La Brea Tar Pits.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Really, now? With the traffic and the parking, it's... okay, fine. The Tar Pits. Let's go.
